# BCGov Crow - v0.13.0

## Release type

Minor release

## Summary

Crow adds a read-only code review agent and reusable skill for local diffs
and hosted GitHub or Azure DevOps changes. Application development now uses
the same review method after implementation checks. Reviews deliver only
verified, actionable findings in chat; publishing remains an explicit,
separate user decision.

## Highlights

- Review local comparisons and GitHub or Azure DevOps pull requests, including
  full changed-file inventory and coverage checks.
- Receive concise, de-duplicated, revision-specific findings with severity,
  confidence, impact, and a concrete correction.

## Changes

- Added the Crow Code Review Agent and skill to the full Crow package and
  Starter Package collection, with provider-specific guidance loaded only
  when relevant.
- Added the code review skill to the application-development completion
  workflow and to the Security Remediation collection that bundles it.
- Aligned package, plugin, README, and collection versions for the new minor
  release.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed; 227 files selected.
- Archive inspection: Pending; no release archive has been generated.
- Additional checks: Release-script and asset-dependency tests passed;

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.13.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.13.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
